sections.title: Predictive Analytics Applications for Chicago Organizations
sections.description: Production-grade predictive analytics built specifically for Chicago's enterprise and regulated industries.

items.title: Financial Services: Fraud and Risk Prediction
items.description: Chicago's financial markets — CME Group, CBOE, banking, derivatives clearing, and the broader Midwest financial services sector — generate predictive analytics requirements that reflect the specific dynamics of derivatives trading, options market-making, and commercial banking. Transaction fraud detection: real-time scoring of payment transactions, futures margin calls, and trading anomalies — trained on Chicago-specific transaction patterns and the fraud signatures distinctive to derivatives market manipulation vs. retail payment fraud. Credit risk scoring: commercial and consumer credit models for Chicago's community banks, credit unions, and commercial lenders — with FCRA adverse action reason codes and SR 26-2 model validation documentation. Counterparty risk analytics: credit exposure modeling for Chicago's clearing and prime brokerage operations — ML on financial counterparty data for dynamic credit limit optimization. Cost: $50,000–$135,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | SR 26-2 documentation standard.
items.label: Financial Services

items.title: Insurance: Underwriting and Claims Analytics
items.description: Chicago's insurance concentration — Allstate, CNA, Zurich North America, AON — creates predictive analytics demand for underwriting risk scoring, claims frequency and severity prediction, fraud detection, and customer lifetime value modeling adapted to the actuarial context of insurance applications. Cost: $45,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Insurance

items.title: Demand Forecasting for Logistics and Retail
items.description: Chicago's logistics hub position — the intersection of major rail networks, O'Hare freight, and highway infrastructure — makes demand forecasting for inventory and logistics one of the city's highest-value AI applications. ML time-series forecasting models predicting product demand by SKU, channel, and region for Chicago retailers and distributors reduce inventory carrying cost and stockout risk simultaneously. Cost: $40,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks.
items.label: Demand Forecasting

items.title: Healthcare: Patient Risk and Operations Prediction
items.description: Advocate Aurora, Northwestern Medicine, Rush, and Chicago's major health systems. ML patient risk stratification for readmission, deterioration, and ED utilization prediction — integrated with Epic or Cerner EHR systems via FHIR APIs with HIPAA-compliant data handling. Cost: $55,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 14–22 weeks | HIPAA standard.
items.label: Healthcare

items.title: Manufacturing and Industrial Predictive Analytics
items.description: Chicago's manufacturing sector — discrete and process manufacturing across the metropolitan area. Equipment failure prediction from sensor data, process quality prediction, and yield optimization ML for Chicago's industrial clients. Cost: $45,000–$110,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: Manufacturing

items.title: Churn Prediction (SaaS/Insurance)
items.description: Identifying at-risk customers 30–90 days before cancellation — enabling proactive retention for Chicago's SaaS, insurance, and financial services companies. Cost: $35,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 10–18 weeks.
